description: This file implements a login screen in Flutter, managing user input, validation, persistence of last username, and navigation to a calculator screen upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents a login interface, handling user input and navigation.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen managing UI state, input controllers, and persistence logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, restoring the last used username.

methods.name: _restoreLastUsername
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and sets the last username from shared preferences.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text editing controllers.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates input, updates preferences, and navigates to the calculator screen if valid.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the login UI with text fields, validation, and a login button.
